title: Psalm 23
firstLine: The Lord is my shepherd; no want shall come nigh. Within the green pastures He makes me to lie. Beside the still waters He leads me to rest; My soul He revives when I'm faint and oppressed.

lines: The Lord is my shepherd; no want shall come nigh. Within the green pastures He makes me to lie. Beside the still waters He leads me to rest; My soul He revives when I'm faint and oppressed.
In right ways He leads me for His own name's sake. although through the vale of death's shadow I walk, since Thou art there with me, no evil i fear; thy rod and thy staff give me comfort and cheer.
Thou hast me a table before all my foes. My head Thou anointest, my cup overflows. thy goodness and mercy attend my life's ways; I'll dwell in the house of the Lord endless days.
